assignments.sharedRootCause: One builder decision, four families. The WA host writes held facts into measured cells and declares 'legal elections or checkboxes' under explicitSafetyPolicy.neverWritten, and its participant instruction set defers filing, notice, service, fee and hearing to the participant in a single sentence. Repairing one family in isolation will not fix the other three; the instruction generator and the route-election decision are the units of repair.
assignments.doNotRepairBy: Do not close FILING_DESTINATION, FEE_AND_WAIVER or SERVICE by writing a generic sentence.
